$comment: Budgets are tests (CLAUDE.md). Raising one needs an ADR. Bytes, except frames (ms). initialJsGzipBytes is set from the Phase 0 measurement plus headroom (docs/handoff/phase-00.md); art and audio leave room inside the 30 MB Android download target. Frame budgets per device tier come from the Kanche Visual Benchmark v1 (ADR-0002): on the reference budget phone at least 95% of frames within 16.7 ms and none over 50 ms during a shot; on mid-range at least 99% and none over 33 ms. They are checked against device frame reports (pnpm budgets --frames), which Phase 3 starts producing.
